Asset type: canonical career-world skill concept sheet for skill/go@v1
Input images: none by default. If the same canonical tracer PNG is attached, use it only as a style and identity reference; never as an edit target, geometry source, coordinate truth, or permission to change topology.
Primary request: A long low double-gable workshop wraps a straight open service spine, with one clipped corner loading bay and a short raised rear monitor shed.
Scene/backdrop: isolated asset on a near-black navy technical drafting field with a faint true-isometric grid and no surrounding scene.
Style/medium: restrained technical-cartography line art, matte low-value faces, thin parallel strokes, minimal bloom, traceable hard edges, no perspective convergence.
Composition/framing: one isolated canonical identity only, centered with generous margin; show LOD-0, LOD-1, LOD-2, and one solid silhouette inset as separated unobscured panels.
Projection: orthographic true-isometric; camera azimuth 225 degrees from north, look direction 45 degrees, elevation 35.264 degrees, roll 0; +Y projects upper-left; no authored rotation.
Lighting/mood: fixed graphic face values, quiet and legible, no cinematic lighting and no cast shadow.
Color palette: global near-black navy field #080B10, surface #0D1219, ink #F0EEE7, focus #8CE8F8; keep all eight semantic palette slots explicit and do not bake in an employer color. Emissive detail may cover at most 3 percent of visible face area.
Materials/textures: matte technical-cartography faces only; top, lit side, and shadow side use deterministic palette values.
Text (verbatim): none.
Constraints: Reusable neutral Go technology geometry. Fast, simple massing is architectural only; employer variants change palette and placement, never geometry. Keep footprint, centroid, orientation, primary masses, roofline, facade rhythm, and fixed empty sign-slot anchor unchanged across all LOD panels. LOD changes only secondary doors, windows, seams, roof equipment, and other non-silhouette detail. Geometry must be reconstructable as deterministic SVG without guessing hidden edges.
Avoid: generated text, labels, initials, numbers, pseudo-text, logos, wordmarks, mascots, or watermarks; perspective convergence, camera rotation, cast shadows, PBR, photorealism, glass, chrome, cyberpunk neon, or fantasy styling; graph or dashboard layouts, logo plinths, unsupported factual architecture, private details, metrics, or real-campus implication; melted joins, impossible stairs or windows, disconnected masses, inconsistent axes, hidden geometry, or silhouette-changing LOD drift; Go wordmark; gopher mascot; speed lines; employer colors.
Easter egg rule: No easter egg in the canonical sheet. Any later approved decoration must be a single optional LOD-2 attachment that does not alter footprint, silhouette, evidence, or interaction.
reference_roles: Optional same-canonical tracer PNG only: use it as a style and identity reference, never as an edit target, geometry source, coordinate truth, or permission to change topology.

input_image_policy.art_lead_override: Only the art lead may attach the passing tracer PNG for this exact canonical asset, and only when eligible_same_canonical_tracer_path is non-null.
